title: Locality of the polynomial algebra adjoining p-th roots
statement: Let p be prime, A a commutative local F_p-algebra, n a natural number and a : Fin n → A. Define B = A[X_i]/(X_i^p-a_i), using [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Then B is local and A → B is a local ring homomorphism. The polynomial quotient is the actual construction Algebra.pthRootAlgebra; no arbitrary field or ring is chosen. The empty family is allowed.

source.place: Tag 07E5, proof of (2) => (4); read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07E5 because the local literature checkout is absent. The local quotient argument is the general finite p-root version of the local-base-change construction, expanded by P3 using monic division, integral contraction and Frobenius uniqueness. Also Algebra Tags 00GQ (lying over) and 0BR8 (uniqueness from powers in the image), read online.

proof.text: Form the actual polynomial quotient by the monic equations X_i^p-a_i. Successive monic polynomial division gives an A-basis consisting of monomials with all exponents less than p: division gives spanning, and the unique reduced remainder gives independence. In particular the coefficient map is injective, and B is finite free and integral over A.

Every maximal ideal of B contracts to m_A, by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-algebra-local-radical]. The closed fibre is K[X_i]/(X_i^p-a_bar_i). Every residue field of this finite-dimensional K-algebra embeds into an algebraic closure of K, since it is a finite extension. Frobenius injectivity makes the value of each variable unique, so all such evaluations have the same kernel; the closed fibre has at most one prime. Lying over supplies a prime over m_A by [lem-weil-pbc-integral-injective-lying-over]. Consequently B has exactly one maximal ideal, hence is local. Its contraction is m_A, which proves that A → B is local. For n=0 the quotient is A.

lean.statement:
theorem pthRootAlgebra_local (p n : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra (ZMod p) A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (a : Fin n → A) :
    ∃ hlocal : IsLocalRing (pthRootAlgebra p n A a),
      letI := hlocal
      IsLocalHom (algebraMap A (pthRootAlgebra p n A a))
